name: Hirai Yoshiki
source: Pervert high school student who always thinks about lewd things. While he gets along with his girlfriend Miki after accepting her confession just because he wanted a girlfriend, he can't get excited when they have sex and is at loss about their relationship. However, it's not long before he gets to meet Miki's mother who would change his life forever.
